_about: Central and state schemes and the stress, opportunity and archetype signals they respond to. A scheme is suggested for an MWS when (a) it addresses at least one triggered stress or opportunity, or the MWS has one of the listed archetypes with share >= 0.15 and a listed stress, (b) its 'state' is null or matches, and (c) its optional 'condition' holds (expression over indicators, ctx.<dimension>, share_<archetype>, district, state). 'caution' text is shown when present. Scheme names, coverage and periods change; every entry should be checked against current guidelines before use. Status reflects knowledge to mid-2026.

schemes.name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGS - natural resource management works
schemes.purpose: Wage employment through public and individual works; at least 60% of expenditure on agriculture and allied NRM works.
relevant_components: plantation and horticulture on private land
schemes.notes: Default convergence vehicle; works planned through the gram panchayat labour budget.

schemes.name: PMKSY - Watershed Development Component (WDC 2.0)
schemes.purpose: Ridge-to-valley treatment of rainfed and degraded watersheds.
schemes.notes: Project areas are sanctioned by the state; check whether the MWS lies in a WDC 2.0 project.

schemes.name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (micro-irrigation)
schemes.purpose: Subsidy for drip and sprinkler irrigation and small water-harvesting structures.
schemes.caution: Micro-irrigation saves water per hectare but often expands irrigated area; pair with area or volume caps where the aquifer is over-exploited.

schemes.name: PMKSY - Har Khet Ko Pani / Command Area Development and Water Management
schemes.purpose: Close the gap between irrigation potential created and used; field channels, drainage, water users' associations.

schemes.name: Atal Bhujal Yojana (Atal Jal)
schemes.purpose: Community-led demand-side groundwater management in water-stressed gram panchayats.
schemes.notes: Covers selected over-exploited/critical blocks in Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, MP, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and UP. Check whether the block is covered (Maharashtra: 13 districts incl. Amravati and Pune; Rajasthan and UP: verify Udaipur and Ballia). Scheme period was extended beyond 2025 - verify.

schemes.name: Jal Shakti Abhiyan: Catch the Rain
schemes.purpose: Annual campaign for rainwater harvesting, renovation of water bodies and recharge, implemented through convergence.

schemes.name: Mission Amrit Sarovar
schemes.purpose: Develop or rejuvenate at least 75 water bodies of about 1 acre per district.
schemes.notes: Implemented through MGNREGS and other schemes; phase 2 continues - verify targets.

schemes.name: Repair, Renovation and Restoration (RRR) of water bodies
schemes.purpose: Restore storage and command of tanks and traditional water bodies.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM (solar pumps and solarised feeders)
schemes.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.purpose: Solar pumps for farmers and solarisation of agricultural feeders.
schemes.caution: Near-zero marginal cost of pumping can accelerate depletion. Avoid new pumps in over-exploited and critical blocks unless paired with metering and caps; Component C with grid buy-back is preferable.
schemes.notes: Several states require a no-objection from the groundwater authority in over-exploited blocks.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.purpose: Crop insurance against yield loss, prevented sowing and post-harvest loss.
schemes.notes: Some states run their own schemes instead (check state notification for the season).

schemes.name: NMSA - Rainfed Area Development
schemes.purpose: Integrated farming systems for rainfed areas: crop-livestock-tree combinations, water harvesting.
schemes.notes: Implemented under RKVY in recent years - verify current component.

schemes.name: NFSM / RKVY - Targeting Rice Fallow Areas
schemes.purpose: Pulses and oilseeds on rice fallows in eastern states.
schemes.notes: Rice-fallow programme focus states: Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal (verify AP and UP inclusion).

schemes.name: National Mission on Edible Oils (oilseeds)
schemes.purpose: Expand oilseed area including on rice fallows and intercropping.

schemes.name: National Mission on Natural Farming
schemes.purpose: Chemical-free farming clusters with bio-input resource centres.

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture
schemes.purpose: Orchards, protected cultivation, post-harvest infrastructure.
schemes.caution: New irrigated orchards raise water demand in over-exploited blocks.

schemes.name: Agroforestry (Har Medh Par Ped / Sub-Mission on Agroforestry)
schemes.purpose: Trees on farm boundaries and in mosaic landscapes.

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission (fodder and feed sub-mission)
schemes.purpose: Fodder production, small-ruminant and poultry entrepreneurship, grassland development.
relevant_components: development of grazing land and fodder banks

schemes.name: Green India Mission
schemes.department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
schemes.purpose: Increase forest and tree cover and restore degraded ecosystems.

schemes.name: Compensatory afforestation (CAMPA)
schemes.purpose: Afforestation and forest restoration from compensatory funds.
relevant_components: soil and moisture conservation in forests

schemes.name: Green Credit Programme (tree plantation on degraded land)
schemes.purpose: Tradeable green credits for planting on notified degraded land parcels.
relevant_components: tree plantation on degraded land banks
schemes.notes: CoRE Stack lists Green Credit projects per MWS (none means no project). Credits accrue to private/PSU entities; check that community rights are respected.

schemes.name: Forest Rights Act - individual and community forest resource rights
schemes.purpose: Recognise individual and community forest rights; CFR management plans can draw on MGNREGS and CAMPA.

schemes.name: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan
schemes.purpose: Saturation of infrastructure and livelihoods in tribal-majority villages and aspirational-district tribal villages.
relevant_components: FRA patta holder support (agriculture, fisheries, livestock)
schemes.notes: Villages with >= 50% ST population and >= 500 ST persons (verify list).

schemes.name: PM-JANMAN (Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups)
schemes.purpose: Housing, roads, water, livelihoods for PVTG habitations.
schemes.notes: PVTGs present: Paharia (Godda), Bonda/Didayi/Langia Saora etc. (Koraput), Savara (Srikakulam), Kolam (Amaravati), Katkari (Pune), Sahariya (not Udaipur) - verify habitation lists.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana (NTFP value addition)
schemes.purpose: Collective processing and marketing of minor forest produce.

schemes.name: Flood Management and Border Areas Programme
schemes.purpose: Central assistance to states for flood control and anti-erosion works.

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission (drinking water, source sustainability)
schemes.purpose: Functional household tap connections with source sustainability and water-quality monitoring.
schemes.notes: Ballia: arsenic in shallow aquifers; Amaravati Purna tract: salinity.

schemes.name: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp (PoCRA)
schemes.purpose: Climate-resilient agriculture in drought-prone Vidarbha and Marathwada villages (phase 2 from 2024).
schemes.notes: Amravati is a PoCRA district; check village list for phase 2.

schemes.name: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan 2.0
schemes.department: Soil and Water Conservation Department, Maharashtra
schemes.purpose: Village-level water budgeting and water conservation works.

schemes.name: Gaal-mukt Dharan, Gaal-yukt Shivar
schemes.department: Soil and Water Conservation Department, Maharashtra
schemes.purpose: Desilt reservoirs and tanks and spread the silt on farms.

schemes.name: Magel Tyala Shettale (farm ponds on demand)
schemes.purpose: Individual farm ponds for protective irrigation.
schemes.caution: Lined ponds filled from borewells increase evaporation losses and groundwater draft.

schemes.name: Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana
schemes.purpose: Wells, pumps, farm ponds and inputs for Scheduled Tribe farmers.
schemes.caution: New wells in over-exploited blocks need groundwater authority clearance.

schemes.name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Phalbag Lagvad Yojana
schemes.purpose: Orchard plantation on farmers' land.
schemes.caution: Avoid water-intensive orchards (mandarin, banana) in over-exploited blocks.

schemes.name: Andhra Pradesh Community-managed Natural Farming (APCNF)
schemes.purpose: Natural farming with pre-monsoon dry sowing and year-round cover.

schemes.name: Andhra Pradesh Drought Mitigation Project
schemes.purpose: Drought resilience in Ananthapur and other Rayalaseema districts: water, livestock, crop diversification.
schemes.status: Project period may have ended - verify

schemes.name: AP sheep and goat development (insurance, deworming, fodder)
schemes.purpose: Support for small-ruminant herders.

schemes.name: ITDA tribal sub-plan programmes (Seethampeta ITDA)
schemes.purpose: Horticulture (cashew, mango), podu land development and livelihoods in tribal mandals.

schemes.name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
schemes.purpose: Fruit-tree plantations on fallow and upland through MGNREGS.
relevant_components: mango and mixed fruit orchards on uplands

schemes.name: Neelambar-Pitambar Jal Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.purpose: Water conservation through MGNREGS (TCB, farm ponds, field bunds).

schemes.name: Didi Bari Yojana
schemes.purpose: Nutrition kitchen gardens for women in MGNREGS households.

schemes.name: Jharkhand micro-irrigation and tank renovation (Jal Nidhi / Mukhyamantri Jal Samriddhi)
schemes.purpose: Ponds, tank renovation and micro-lift irrigation.

schemes.name: Odisha Millets Mission (Shree Anna Abhiyan)
schemes.purpose: Revive millets in tribal districts with procurement and processing.

schemes.name: Odisha Integrated Irrigation Project for Climate Resilient Agriculture
schemes.department: Department of Water Resources, Odisha / World Bank
schemes.purpose: Tank renovation and crop diversification in tank commands.
schemes.status: Project period may have ended - verify

schemes.name: Jalanidhi / Deep Borewell Secha Karyakram
schemes.purpose: Subsidy for shallow tube wells, dug wells and borewells.
schemes.caution: Only where groundwater extraction is low (Koraput blocks are Safe).

schemes.name: CM-KISAN (income support)
schemes.purpose: Income support to small and landless households (successor to KALIA).

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Jal Swavlamban Abhiyan 2.0
schemes.department: Watershed Development and Soil Conservation Department, Rajasthan
schemes.purpose: Village water self-reliance through ridge-to-valley water harvesting.

schemes.name: Rajasthan farm pond (khet talai) and diggi subsidy
schemes.department: Agriculture Department, Rajasthan (Rajasthan Krishi Vikas Yojana)
schemes.purpose: Farm ponds and storage tanks for protective irrigation.

schemes.name: Rajasthan Forestry and Biodiversity Development Project
schemes.purpose: Forest and pasture restoration with joint forest management committees.

schemes.name: Gochar / charagah (pasture) development under MGNREGS and state funds
schemes.purpose: Fencing, fodder sowing and water points on village pastures.

schemes.name: Khet Talab Yojana
schemes.purpose: Farm ponds with subsidy for protective irrigation and recharge.

schemes.name: UP flood management and anti-erosion works (state plan)
schemes.purpose: Embankments, spurs and drainage for Ganga-Ghaghra floods.

schemes.name: UP Ground Water (Management and Regulation) Act 2019 - registration and recharge
schemes.purpose: Registration of borewells, recharge obligations, protection in over-exploited blocks.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card scheme (with Soil Health and Fertility component of RKVY)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.purpose: Soil testing every two years and nutrient recommendations for each farm.
schemes.notes: Pair with organic-matter building (natural farming, compost) where organic carbon is low.

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
schemes.purpose: Self-help groups, federations, bank linkage and livelihood support for poor rural households.
schemes.notes: Low SHG coverage in Mission Antyodaya data is the entry point.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
schemes.purpose: Inland fisheries development, including pond fish culture, seed and inputs.
relevant_components: pond construction and renovation for fish
schemes.notes: Rights over village tanks (panchayat lease, fishermen societies) decide who can benefit.

schemes.name: Forest Fire Prevention and Management Scheme
schemes.department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
schemes.purpose: Fire lines, fire watchers, community participation and fire alerts in fire-prone forests.
schemes.notes: FSI fire alerts are sent to registered users; check whether the forest division uses them.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
schemes.purpose: Pucca houses for households in kuccha or dilapidated houses.
relevant_components: convergence with NREGA wages and SBM toilets
schemes.notes: A high kuccha-house share in Mission Antyodaya data indicates unmet need.

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana and bank mitra (business correspondent) outlets
schemes.purpose: Basic bank accounts and banking within reach of every village through business correspondents.
schemes.notes: RBI targets a banking outlet within 5 km of every village.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Khanij Kshetra Kalyan Yojana (District Mineral Foundation)
schemes.purpose: Spends mining royalties collected by each District Mineral Foundation on areas and people affected by mining.
schemes.caution: Applies only in districts with a District Mineral Foundation and mining-affected areas listed by it.
schemes.notes: Drinking water and pollution control are among the high-priority sectors in the guidelines.
